headline: Robust Japanese Loan Demand Expands Scope for Further BOJ Interest Rate Hikes
summary: Persistent strength in Japanese commercial loan demand is providing the Bank of Japan with additional policy room to pursue further interest rate increases.
why: The Bank of Japan is normalizing its monetary policy after decades of ultra-loose settings, a shift with profound ramifications for Japanese bond yields and the yen.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Strong loan demand bolsters the case for tighter monetary policy and higher Bank of Japan policy rates.
